envelope.heading: DCAT Catalog
envelope.description: A DCAT-AP 3 catalog (JSON-LD) of the Assets in a collection or folder, read as you. Give `scope`: the collection's qualifiedName or GUID. DigitalProducts and Agreements are Bitol's and are named in the notes, not exported; validated against the vendored DCAT-AP 3.0.1 SHACL shapes. Run with output_format DOCUMENT.
